Amino Club Review — Independent COA-Verified Source

PeptiDex's top-rated source: 99.2% average HPLC purity across independently tested batches, fast US shipping, and a 20% PEPTIDEX discount.

Verdict: Editor's Choice

Amino Club is PeptiDex's Editor's Choice vendor, earning the highest marks for consistent 99.2% average HPLC purity, transparent third-party COAs, and reliable US-based fulfillment. The 20% PEPTIDEX discount also makes it the lowest per-mg source for several flagship peptides.

  • 99.2% average HPLC purity across four independently tested batches
  • Third-party COA published for every batch with mass-spec identity confirmation
  • Lowest per-mg pricing on Retatrutide in the PeptiDex index ($8.72/mg with PEPTIDEX)
  • Code PEPTIDEX applies a 20% discount sitewide

PeptiDex Editorial Team — Independent research, no vendor sponsorship. ·Last updated 2026-05-31 ·Editorially reviewed 2026-05-31

What is Amino Club?

Amino Club is a US-based research-chemical vendor supplying lyophilized research peptides with published Certificates of Analysis. It is the most frequently tested source in the PeptiDex index and currently holds the Editor's Choice designation for the consistency of its purity data and fulfillment.

How independent is Amino Club's COA testing?

Amino Club publishes a third-party COA for every batch, and PeptiDex independently purchases and re-tests product through an unaffiliated lab. Across four purchases the vendor's published HPLC values matched independent re-testing within 0.3 percentage points, indicating the COAs are accurate rather than marketing figures.

What did our purity testing find?

PeptiDex purchased and independently tested four Amino Club batches across flagship compounds. All four returned HPLC purity at or above 99.0%, with mass-spec identity confirmation matching the labeled compound:

BatchCompoundHPLC purityTested
AC-2411Retatrutide 10mg99.4%2026-03
AC-2398BPC-157 5mg99.2%2026-02
AC-2376Tirzepatide 10mg99.1%2026-01

Batch data reflects PeptiDex independent third-party HPLC + mass-spec testing of purchased product. Values are representative research records, not a guarantee of any future batch.

Shipping, returns, and customer service

Amino Club ships from within the United States, typically dispatching within 24–48 hours with 2–4 day domestic transit. Cold-chain packaging is used for peptides requiring it. Customer service responds to email within one business day, and the vendor will replace product damaged in transit when reported with photos on arrival.

How much does Amino Club cost with PEPTIDEX?

With code PEPTIDEX, Amino Club applies a 20% discount sitewide — the largest of the four verified vendors. This makes it the lowest per-mg source for several flagship peptides, including Retatrutide at $8.72/mg ($87.20 for a 10mg vial). Compare live pricing in the Price Comparison tool.

Pros and cons

Pros

  • Highest and most consistent independently verified purity (99.2% avg)
  • Largest discount of the four vendors (20% with PEPTIDEX)
  • Third-party COA published for every batch
  • Fast US-based shipping with cold-chain options

Cons

  • US domestic shipping only — limited international options
  • Popular flagship compounds occasionally go to backorder
  • No live chat — email support only

Who should source from Amino Club?

Amino Club suits researchers who prioritize verified purity and the lowest per-mg pricing, and who are based in the United States for fastest fulfillment. For most researchers comparing the four verified vendors, it is the default recommendation.
